Name: Rusty Sword
Description: Little more than a fragile stick of rusted metal. Where did you find this and why did you bring it into a dungeon?

Name: Short Sword
Description: A rogue’s short sword, about 3 feet long. Suitable for defense when nothing else is available.

Name: Long Sword
Description: A typical knight’s sword. No duller than any other blade but the length provides for extra reach.

Name: Spear
Description: A simple, almost primitive, spear topped with an iron sheaf. Surprisingly accurate but does little damage.

Name: Crossbow
Description: A complex, wooden crossbow with a winch mechanism. Fires bolts with tremendous force.

Name: Long Bow
Description: A traditional wooden bow favored by the Elves. Tremendously accurate but limited by human strength.

Name: Scimitar
Description: A curved blade from a foreign land. Hard to use but good at opening wounds.

Name: Katana
Description: A rare weapon forged in Eastern lands. Light and wieldy, able to slice with ease.

Name: Morningstar
Description: A metal, spiked cudgel employed by certain priestly sects. Robust and easy to use.

Name: Warhammer
Description: A weighty iron hammer on a long haft. Slow and unforgiving but able to deal powerful blows.

Name: Glaive
Description: A large, curved blade affixed to a spear-length shaft. Surprisingly devastating in the right hands.

Name: Trident
Description: Once a tool for fishing, it has been militarized to impressive effect. Favored by mysterious clans of the Central Sea.

Name: Odachi
Description: A huge katana made for slicing the legs off cavalry horses. Extremely slow but devastating.

Name: Rapier
Description: A light, quick, pointed weapon intended for fencing. Highly accurate but can only deal slight damage.

Name: Reiterschwerter
Description: A cavalry saber with a basket hilt. Similar to a long sword although the hilt grants slight defense.

Name: Lance
Description: A large, heavy spear meant for thrusting on horseback. Moderately effective on foot.

Name: Whip
Description: A long, flexible strap meant for taming beasts. Incredibly fast but can only produce superficial wounds.

Name: Barbed Wire
Description: Only a maniac would wrap barbed wire around one’s fists. What do you intend to do with this?

Name: Meteor Hammer
Description: An exotic weapon consisting of heavy metal weights connected via a chain. Awkward to use but can catch opponents off-guard.

Name: Axe
Description: A militarized chopping axe, heavy and slow. A favorite among lesser races who value power above all else.

Name: Club
Description: Nothing more than a weighty piece of debris. Surprisingly effective at bludgeoning.

Name: Bo Staff
Description: A martial staff wielded by Eastern men. Meant for parrying attacks as much as delivering them, thus adding to one’s defense.

Name: Tonfa
Description: A club-like weapon held with a reverse grip. Better than using one’s fists alone. Also meant for parrying attacks, thus adding to one’s defense.

Name: War Banner
Description: A rare find: a spear with a martial banner attached. The banner flutters as it is waved, providing a defensive distraction.

Name: Pistol
Description: A matchlock pistol of simple design. Fires ball rounds. Highly inaccurate but when it does connect it can easily cripple an opponent.

Name: Rifle
Description: A matchlock rifle with a long barrel. Fires ball rounds. Slightly more accurate than a pistol, thanks to its length, and much more damaging. A single shot can fell weaker creatures.

Name: Siege Cannon
Description: A colossal iron cannon capable of firing heavy ammunition. Absurdly weighty and slow. Only a madman would think about firing this.

Name: Urumi
Description: Essentially, a flexible metal whip. Dangerous to the user and rather unwieldly, it nevertheless can sever limbs thanks to its thin steel blade.

Name: Autocross
Description: An ancient weapon of a bygone era. Its boxy construction resembles a cross and it is held with a reverse grip. Emits harnessed light.

Name: Mage’s Staff
Description: A magical staff enchanted to fire balls of energy. Highly accurate but strong creatures can shrug off the blasts.

Name: Battlemage Staff
Description: A powerful staff enchanted with war magic. Fires bolts of mana.

Name: Kunai
Description: Trowel-shaped daggers that can be thrown with high accuracy. Favored by Eastern assassins.

Name: Lensman Armillary
Description: A floating metal orb controlled by a wrist brace, which syncronizes with the user’s thoughts. Fires beams of light.

Name: Power Glove
Description: A magical, metal glove of ancient construction. Enchanted with battle magic, it allows the user to strike swift, damaging blows.

Name: Archaic Carbine
Description: A rifle-like device of ancient construction. Fires piercing beams of energy.

Name: Mana Manifold
Description: Magical, floating cubes that encircle the user’s hand. Harnesses occult power to project a devastating beam of magical force.

Name: Chakram
Description: A magical ring of psionic energy, telepathically controlled. Can be flung at opponents to deadly effect.

Name: Book of Power
Description: A magical grimoire, enchanted to damage enemies purely by recitation. Thus, it cannot be dodged.

Name: Sapien Cannon
Description: A large, shoulder mounted siege weapon. Highly inaccurate but capable of killing any living creature should they find themselves struck by its beam.

Name: Buckler
Description: A small metal disk affixed to the forearm. Primarily meant to parry small arms, its defense is negligible.

Name: Kite Shield
Description: A standard knight’s shield. Provides decent coverage of the limbs and torse for solid defense.

Name: Tower Shield
Description: A huge steel shield nearly the length of a man. Provides superb defense but impairs one’s accuracy.

Name: Monument Shield
Description: A colossal stone shield graven with a Dwarven visage. Favored by the Dwarves but largely ceremonial as its weight is extremely cumbersome.

Name: Woven Shield
Description: A wicker shield favored by men of the East. Light and sturdy. Able to impart considerable defense although its weak material construction undermines its efficacy.

Name: Orrery Shield
Description: Enchanted orbs encircle the user’s arm and move to intercept incoming strikes. Highly effective although coordinating one’s movements to theirs is sometimes difficult.

Name: Phase Shield
Description: An ancient shield of a bygone era. Normally the size of a buckler. When activated, a green barrier of energy emerges that negates attacks.

Name: Hyper Shield
Description: A purely defensive device, affixed to the user’s arm. It generates a force field around the bearer but such coverage greatly impedes attacks. Used by the ancient men who walk the stars.

Name: Turtle Shell
Description: The shell of some large animal, remade into a shield. Due to its curvature, it impedes attacks although the hide is quite durable.

Name: Spiked Shield
Description: A spiked, weaponized shield used by gladiators. Contributes to the user’s offense although it is meant for bloodsport and thus provides little coverage.

Name: Rations
Description: Simple trail rations. Restores 5 HP.

Name: Potion
Description: An enchanted healing draught. Restores 10 HP.

Name: High Potion
Description: An effective healing draught. Restores 20 HP.

Name: Ex Potion
Description: An extremely effective draught. Restores 50 HP.

Name: Mana Essence
Description: Ambient magical energy condensed into a sphere. Restores 10 MP.

Name: Mana Flux
Description: Ambient magical energy condensed into fine wires. Restores 30 MP.

Name: Mana Crystal
Description: Highly condensed magical energy. Restores 100 MP.

Name: Voodoo Doll
Description: Necromantic doll attuned to the user’s life force. If the user would be killed, the doll is sacrificed instead.

Name: Beacon
Description: Use this to reveal the location of a descending stair case. However, it does not reveal how to get there.

Name: Terror Horn
Description: Blow this horn to frighten away lesser creatures. Instantly kills creatures below level 5 but you receive no experience.

Name: Coin Purse
Description: A bag of golden coinage. Does nothing but holding it increases your score.

Name: Bindor’s Deceit
Description: A fragile pod that you snap, creating enchanted smoke. Negates the enemy’s next attack.

Name: Jethry’s Numenon
Description: A magical plate with numbers etched into it. Reveals the position of enemies on the floor.

Name: Beserker Phial
Description: Drinking this grants +5 damage on the next 5 attacks.

Name: Behelit
Description: Use to instantly transit to the next floor. However, you permanently lose 5 HP.

Name: The Omatrix
Description: Obtain this to win the game. Instantly generates an ascending staircase. Fight your way to the staircase to leave the dungeon!
